description: Dataset of Estimation of the electricity demand of San Juan Neural Networks (Top-down/Bottom-up) is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Eduardo J. Salazar, Mauricio Samper (IEE-UNSJ). This dataset presents the prediction of electricity consumption based on economic data from Argentina that allows estimating the demand per user of the province of San Juan. Two neural network models have been used, firstly, a bottom-up approach to estimate the economic data of electric demand based on the trend. Coverage: national (AR); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: Excel. Size stated: 23121. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
